title: Reset checks should retain the selection-derived item order for the next use
environment: Current phone build; exact mode and persistence conditions still to be recorded.
reproduction_status: User-reported; exact example not independently reproduced during backlog gathering
reproduction: Start with unchecked items in the order 1, 2, 3.
Check item 3, then item 1, then item 2, identifying each by its name rather than its changing row index.
Invoke Reset checks from the drawer.
Inspect the unchecked order immediately and when the list is used again.
actual: The user reports that Reset checks clears the selection without preserving the desired selection-derived ordering, requiring manual reordering on the next use. The exact incorrect resulting order has not been supplied.
expected: Clear the checked flags while retaining the last-in-first-out order established by checking items. For initial order 1, 2, 3 and check sequence 3, 1, 2, the reset order must be 2, 1, 3, and that order must persist for the next use.
impact: The user must reorder a reusable shopping list after resetting it, disrupting the intended workflow. Severity described as major.
source_notes: View.qml invokes ShopView.reset(), which delegates to Model.reset().

Model.reset() repeatedly unchecks the last checked item; setChecked(false) moves the item to the front. A static trace of the simple all-checked example appears consistent with the requested 2, 1, 3 result, so the reported failure needs reproduction before choosing a fix.
Investigate the actual UI flow, mode/editor state, mixed checked/unchecked items, and persistence rather than assuming the model simply changes flags.
The existing checked_state_reorders_persists_and_resets model test verifies that check flags are cleared after reset/reload, but does not assert the final item order after reset.
acceptance_criteria: The user's exact example produces unchecked items ordered 2, 1, 3 after Reset checks.
The resulting order survives saving, switching away and back, and restarting the app.
A second Reset checks does not change an already reset list's order.
Resetting does not lose item identity or content, and handles the editor without inserting it into the saved item order.
Clarify and cover mixed checked/unchecked list behavior during reproduction.
Add an explicit final-order assertion for the reported sequence and verify the real drawer action on the affected build.
open_questions: What exact order appears after reset in the affected build?
Is the wrong order visible immediately, or only after reopening or reusing the list?
Were any items still unchecked or was an editor active when Reset checks was invoked?
For a partially checked list, what is the intended relative placement of reset items and items that were never checked?
evidence: User report and explicit 1,2,3 / check 3,1,2 / reset 2,1,3 example in the QShopper development chat on 2026-10-28.
